expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and a black horizontal bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The bottom navigation bar is pushed below the visible area. Its icons (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) are cut off at the bottom of the screen, with only their top halves visible, and any text labels are hidden entirely.
